subject: Change addReplyErrorFormat to addReplyError when there is no format (#12641)
reason: The change swaps addReplyErrorFormat for addReplyError at four call sites whose message is a plain literal with no % conversion specifiers and no newlines. Both functions emit the identical error reply (addReplyErrorLength + afterErrorReply with flags 0); addReplyErrorFormat only adds a printf/newline-sanitising pass that is a no-op on these literals. The wire bytes, error stats and client behaviour are unchanged on every affected path (ACL SETUSER/GETUSER/DELUSER with spaces in the username, GEORADIUS ANY without COUNT, REPLCONF rdb-filter-only, Lua stack-limit reply), so this is a pure refac
